checks: Each active literal pair or exterior edge implies both endpoint selectors; its incident objects form a clique in the corresponding previously certified compatibility graph.
For every literal endpoint v in selector orbit O_i, the incident count is at most d_v z_v. The code checks every endpoint star and uses d=max_v d_v, so summation gives m P_R <= d N_i.
Each internal-orbit object is counted twice and each cross-orbit object once. The source checks the incidence sum explicitly and preserves this multiplicity in the output row.
All retained Z and Y orbit graphs are hash-bound to complete prior records and cold checks. Degree-one endpoints are recorded as trivial; every remaining endpoint star has at most four vertices.
An attaining clique plus a checked nonedge in every subset of size d+1 is an exact maximum-clique certificate. Larger cliques would contain such a subset.
The cold path verifies all saved star witnesses, target hashes, capacities and resulting signed row coefficients without calling the star search.
No automorphism of a hypothetical completion is assumed. No optimization, incidence feasibility or full-model nonredundancy claim is made.
scope_limits: This is a source-only review. Preparation statistics, tiny controls and case star values were not independently recomputed.

The source writes a result only after the full stage and final deadline check. An exception or timeout therefore gives no complete census certificate; its failed process/log must be retained separately.
